provenance.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished portrait reference page titled "Mr. Bear" with EXACTLY 24 readable studies in FOUR rows of SIX, ivory background, concise cell labels. Subject: Adult broad brown BEAR, round ears, cream short rounded muzzle and chest, brown irises, dark nose, olive canvas work apron with two brass buttons. Retain published source and study identity. Not hedgehog, no quills. Input roles: first 2 image(s) subject SOURCE evidence; next image PinPin 24-study is LAYOUT/DIRECTION ONLY, never species/anatomy/clothing; last family image is warm dimensional BOOK STYLE only. Keep target species in EVERY cell. Match the template grid and opposing left/right poses, NOT its hedgehog appearance. Row1 FACE VIEWS in order: Front: nose/beak centered toward viewer. Left 3/4: nose/beak points to SCREEN LEFT, both eyes visible. Left profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN LEFT. Right 3/4: nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT, both eyes visible. Right profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT. Rear: back, face invisible. Row2 Expressions: Calm, Curious, Happy, Surprised, Sleepy, Mild upset; natural variation no constant grin. Row3 WHOLE BODY VIEWS in order: Front: nose/beak centered toward viewer. Left 3/4: nose/beak points to SCREEN LEFT, both eyes visible. Left profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN LEFT. Right 3/4: nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT, both eyes visible. Right profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT. Rear: back, face invisible. Body must rotate as a whole, including torso and tail; LEFT three-quarter and LEFT profile must face LEFT; RIGHT three-quarter and RIGHT profile must face RIGHT, not duplicate left-facing bodies under right labels. Row4 Normal poses: Sit, Wave, Carry board, Kneel, Reach, Rest. All full bodies framed with margin, same size within each row, clear separate appropriate limbs, no crops or fused anatomy. Preserve target identity and materials. No extra characters, no numeric age or measured height. Retain established adaptation design.

provenance.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE separate portrait CAST INTERACTION reference page titled "Mr. Bear — Cast interactions" with SIX large readable panels in THREE rows of TWO, ivory backdrop, short labels, full bodies and generous margins. FIRST IMAGE is PRIMARY TARGET IDENTITY: current verified target solo sheet. Lock its species, face, body, materials, limbs and clothing in EVERY panel. Other images are target source, actual counterpart identity and published book style; never substitute hedgehogs for target. Target/source basis: Established R17 adaptation study and published art; 1.35 Papa height is a study proposal, not original fact. Explicit participant assignments: Adult brown bear builder, olive canvas apron; Papa adult hedgehog; Beaver adult blue-vest beaver. Family reference: Mama is copper-quilled adult LEFT, Papa broad cooler-quilled adult CENTER, PinPin older child RIGHT, infant excluded. Maintain natural book dimensional rendering, engaged shared gaze, consistent relative size across panels, clear owned paws/wings, grounded feet and support/contact, no merged bodies, extra limbs or cropped tails. PANELS: 1 Shared ground scale: adult apron BEAR, adult hedgehog PAPA, blue-vest BEAVER and child hedgehog PINPIN stand aligned, Bear moderately taller than Papa matching published log source, PinPin half Papa. 2 Carry board: BEAR and hedgehog PAPA share one plank with clearly owned paws at opposite ends. 3 Builder collaboration: BEAR holds board while blue-vest BEAVER points at joint with his own paw, smooth beaver fur/paddle tail, no quills. 4 Gentle hug: kneeling BEAR and standing child hedgehog PINPIN embrace, clear two bodies, child grounded. 5 Pass cup: seated BEAR receives cup from standing hedgehog PAPA paw-to-paw. 6 Wave goodbye: BEAR and child hedgehog PINPIN wave toward one another, full bodies. Labels describe actual shared actions. No solo portrait row or decorative unrelated characters. Preserve established adaptation identity.
